bash -lc 'set -e
src="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions"
dest="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/sessions"
mkdir -p "$dest"
# Find .jsonl files and copy newer ones
copied=""
while IFS= read -r file; do
  rel=${file#${src}/}
  target="$dest/$rel"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname \"$target\")"
  # copy if source is newer or target does not exist
  if [ ! -f "$target" ] || [ "$file" -nt "$target" ]; then
    cp -p "$file" "$target"
    copied+="$rel\n"
  fi
done < <(find "$src" -type f -name "*.jsonl")
cd /home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace
git add sessions/
if git diff --cached --quiet; then

fi
